description.value: Columbia Bakery is a family-owned European specialty bakery operating in Nanaimo since 1972, known for high-quality breads, pastries, and baked German classics like Bee-sting cake. Cyclists stopping in can grab a fresh daily soup or sandwich for a satisfying mid-ride meal. Located at the corner of Bowen and Northfield Road, it is a well-established local institution with decades of community presence.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is a real, operating family bakery at 2151 Bowen Road, Nanaimo, BC, matching the OSM record. The website corroborates the phone number (250-758-7219), fax (250-758-7239), and address. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website; the site focuses on baked goods, soups, and sandwiches. The category 'Groceries' is a loose fit — this is a specialty bakery with some food items, not a general grocery store, but it offers food useful to cyclists so inclusion is appropriate.
